parameters.name: AccessInstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the private instance.

parameters.name: FirewallType
parameters.description:
The type of Cloud Firewall. Valid values:

- **internet**

- **vpc**

- **nat**

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the member account.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

- **creating**: The instance is being created.

- **deleting**: The instance is being deleted.

- **normal**: The instance is running as expected.

- **updating**: The instance is being updated.
